mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item (id, brand_id, name, price, created_date, updated_date) VALUES (#{id}, #{brandId}, #{name}, #{price}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE brand_id = VALUES(brand_id), name = VALUES(name), price = VALUES(price), updated_date = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.brand_id, i.name, i.price, m.like_count, m.view_count FROM item_favorite_meta m JOIN item i ON i.id = m.item_id ORDER BY m.like_count DESC, m.item_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
